dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: I like it a lot. Couldn't think of a better place to say my prayers!

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: I haven't found a drinking spot just yet, though. Don't suppose I could persuade you to build a bar here?

choices.text: Is it... okay for a deacon to drink so much?

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Barbatos brought us seeds and rain on a gentle breeze, so to show our gratitude, we brewed wine from his generous gifts.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Good wine is not only a blessing from the Anemo Archon — it's a symbol of Mondstadt itself.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Given all this, as a member of the Church of Favonius, it'd be far more improper of me to abstain entirely. Wouldn't you agree?

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Wonderful! I know plenty of tavern owners, so leave the drinks procurement to me...

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Oh, and how about a bard to liven things up a little? I know just the right person.
